name: rocket-landing-3d-version2
description: A cinematic JavaScript 3D web experience of a reusable rocket descending from the upper atmosphere and landing vertically on Earth.

scripts.test:e2e:screenshots: npx playwright install chromium && rm -f qa-artifacts/screenshots/*.png && npx playwright test --grep "Desktop Visual Tests.*screenshot:" --project=desktop --timeout=30000 && npx playwright test --grep "Mobile.*mobile screenshot:" --project=mobile --timeout=30000 && npm run analyze:screenshots
scripts.ci:quality: npm ci && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npx playwright install chromium && npm run test:e2e
